guardPlan.assumptions: Priced by the live budget guard (D-015): rate $6.10/h × (allocation + 5 min setup per launch + 5 min idle margin) + $0.10 storage/egress, rounded up to the cent. A rehearsal is 1 h with 2 launches (initialization + checkpoint continuation); the live slot is 15 min with 1 launch. The setup, idle and storage/egress allowances are Labyrinth's assumptions, not PRD numbers, and are unmeasured until a rehearsal replaces them; rate and lengths are PRD. Plan: $8.10 posted + 2 rehearsals + 1 live slot, each evaluated on a reconciled ledger with every earlier allocation reserved at its estimate. The guard approves every step against the $40.00 ceiling: the plan fits.

scenarios.derivation: slot = 6.10 × 15/60 = 1.525 → $1.53; rehearsals = 2 × 1 h × 6.10 = $12.20; plan = 12.20 + 1.53 = $13.73; planned = 13.73 + 8.10 posted = $21.83; remaining = 40.00 − 21.83 = $18.17. Exact decimal arithmetic, rounded half-up to whole cents (the PRD's convention: 1.525 → $1.53). Rounding per line item or rounding the exact totals once gives the same $13.73 and $21.83 here; binary-float round() would give 1.52 / 13.72 / 21.82.
